findings.note: story-014 fixed the permissionless caller-chosen-dispatcher drain (the run-12 valid High) by owner-pinning the minter and dispatcherIndex; residual value-blindness only exploitable via owner misconfiguration (zero-price pinned dispatcher / over-funded pot) => owner-driven, invalid. NOT a regression: this is a confirmed fix of the permissionless vector. Retained as QA design note in phoenix-nft-staking-13. findings.label: M-01
findings.title: MEV / first-claimer front-run of winner-take-all nudge pot
findings.note: NEW at run phoenix-nft-staking-13. Distinct root cause from H-01 (mempool race vs. value-blind gate). Report generated and PoC (poc-MevFrontrunNudge.t.sol) validated passing; moved to submitted. [TRIAGE 2026-05-29] Accepted — valid finding. Mitigation: introduce a `minRewardPayout` parameter so the claimer can use AMM-style slippage mechanics to revert the transaction if their expected reward has been front-run/claimed. This protects an honest batch-minter from spending a large sum and receiving nothing. [TRIAGE 2026-05-30] ACCEPTED as residual (user triage 2026-05-30). Threat model verified against batchMint @ 9be4a87: (cond.2) claiming the nudge requires paying nudgeSize×mintPrice for real mints — the owner-pinned minter/dispatcher (story-009) make a free claim impossible (verified L257-259, L270); (cond.1) the minReward floor (L278-279) reverts the loser's batch atomically so a sniped user never overpays for a gone reward. Winner-take-all MEV capture remains by design and is accepted: nudge reward is a fraction of NFT mint cost, NFTs have no secondary market (only the staking pool), so a pure MEV bot cannot recoup in one tx — a front-runner who claims must genuinely join the protocol, reducing the issue to an ordinary gas auction among real participants. ACCEPTANCE INVARIANT (owner-operational, not code-enforced): keep the nudge pot < nudgeSize×mintPrice; if the yield funnel ever lets the pot exceed the cost of nudgeSize mints, pure-profit MEV returns. Also assumes a non-zero dispatcher mint price when the nudge is funded. [phoenix-nft-staking-16 RE-TRIAGE] The acceptance invariant 'keep pot < nudgeSize x mintPrice' does NOT bound loss if the minted NFTs carry realizable (resellable/redeemable) value: a searcher who realizes NFT value nets ~pot>0 for ANY pot size, so the giveaway is raced to zero on every refill — the 'NFTs have no secondary market' premise of the 2026-05-30 acceptance no longer holds if a market/redemption path exists (RETRIAGE-001 / ECON-002 / cross-ref F-01 lineage). Over-funding facet (PATTERN-002) is a non-obvious Law-3 owner footgun ('fund the incentive' silently == 'set a sweepable bounty'). Severity ceiling RE-CONFIRMED MEDIUM (NOT secretly High: no principal theft, honest minters still receive NFTs and story-015 minReward reverts a sniped honest caller atomically; loss bounded by owner funding; mempool ordering race, not an unconditional drain). Status PRESERVED as acknowledged (authoritative human triage; NOT auto-reopened by finding-manager). Recommend human re-triage of the acceptance + consideration of a value-bounded payout (cap nudge to caller-contributed value) rather than full-balance winner-take-all.
findings.severityNote: [phoenix-nft-staking-14] PARTIALLY MITIGATED by story-015's minReward fix; residual still open at Medium. minReward correctly closes the loser-overpay leg (a sniped honest caller now reverts atomically instead of minting for a gone reward), but does NOT stop the front-runner from WINNING the winner-take-all balance-based pot — the MEV capture root cause persists. Not a regression (never marked fixed). Not re-reported as new (residual of acknowledged). See follow-on L-05 (minReward==0 default opt-out) for the integration footgun this mitigation introduces. Status left acknowledged (authoritative human triage). [phoenix-nft-staking-15] Still present, re-confirmed by PATTERN-003 against HEAD 5f863d2. story-016 strictly MITIGATES the issue further: the snapshot-before-loop change means the winner no longer recoups their own donations, reducing MEV profitability. Not a regression; status left acknowledged (authoritative human triage). [phoenix-nft-staking-16] Re-confirmed present at HEAD 5f863d2 (cold --full re-scan); lastSeenRun bumped to phoenix-nft-staking-16; acknowledged status preserved (see the RE-TRIAGE note in the note field — the acceptance invariant no longer bounds loss if NFTs are realizable).

findings.label: L-01
findings.title: batchMint lacks nonReentrant; ERC1155 onERC1155Received fires mid-loop
findings.severityNote: [phoenix-nft-staking-14] Re-examined with a decisive validated Tier-3 PoC (poc-L01-reentrancy.t.sol, 4 cases, all pass against real source @ 9be4a87). VERDICT: STAYS LOW. The missing nonReentrant guard is real, but the High escalation (third-party fund theft) is NOT supported: the clean reentrancy theft of an honest multi-mint caller's in-flight funds atomically reverts (the nested frame's forceApprove(minter,0) at L261 revokes the outer loop's approval); the only value-moving reentrancy paths require honest-caller misconfiguration (over-fund + designate attacker as recipient = known-invalid user mistake); the donated-paymentToken sweep is documented intended behavior with an owner rescueERC20 hatch. Recommended fix: add OZ ReentrancyGuard; make the refund credit a recorded amount instead of balanceOf(this). [phoenix-nft-staking-15] Still present, re-confirmed by SLITHER-001/PATTERN-001 against HEAD 5f863d2. Not exploitable beyond Low. Status unchanged (submitted).

findings.label: L-05
findings.title: minReward==0 default silently opts out of the slippage guard
findings.note: NEW Low at run phoenix-nft-staking-14 (untriaged). Root cause: batchMint's minReward (story-015's slippage guard against M-01) defaults to 0 for backward compat; an integrating front-end that omits the param re-exposes M-01 in full. Integration footgun. Distinct from M-01 (this is the opt-out default of the mitigation, not the MEV race itself). [TRIAGE 2026-05-30] WONT-FIX at the contract level (user triage 2026-05-30). The minReward==0 default cannot be removed in-contract: legitimate non-nudge batches (count < nudgeSize) must pass minReward=0, so the contract cannot force a non-zero floor globally. INTEGRATION REQUIREMENT (carried forward, not dropped): user condition 1 ('a normal user never mints-and-gets-zero') holds ONLY if the front-end derives and passes a non-zero, pot-based minReward (AMM-slippage style) for every nudge-qualifying (count >= nudgeSize) batch. This obligation now lives at the integration/UI layer, not the contract. Closed as wont-fix on the contract; the front-end enforcement is the responsible owner of condition 1.

findings.label: M-02
findings.title: emergencyWithdraw skips _recomputeSchedule/_updatePool, leaving stale rewardRate that over-emits the reward budget to surviving stakers
findings.humanReviewFlag: severity (Medium vs High) — confirmed-live with PoC; classifier resolved to MEDIUM (the dramatic 100x drain is Implausible-High only, gated on a post-exit inactivity window the attacker cannot control). High note preserved per conflicting-severity rule.
findings.note: NEW Medium at run phoenix-nft-staking-16 (cold --full re-scan of HEAD 5f863d2). emergencyWithdraw decrements totalStaked but skips _updatePool/_recomputeSchedule and never advances lastRewardTime, so the next _updatePool over-emits the reward budget to survivors by oldTotal/newTotal (100x). Solvency invariant holds throughout (over-draw clamped to rewardBudget at NFTStaker.sol:329) => value-leak / runway drain, NOT insolvency or principal theft. Violates the M-03 'no participation multiplier' Critical Invariant => cross-referenced as spec-conformance F-01 (carries the LIVE Medium per Law 1; NOT collapsed into QA noise). Submission-grade PoC validated PASS (2/2) by poc-validator against unmodified src @ 5f863d2 (workspace/phoenix-nft-staking/test/poc-M02-EmergencyWithdrawOverEmission.t.sol: test_M02_emergencyWithdraw_inflatesSurvivorEmission, test_M02_selfProfit_recoverPrincipalThenSidecarDrains; written GREEN). report-writer emitted the H/M submission; reportPath set.

findings.label: L-06
findings.title: Transient solvency-invariant window: topUp/setTargetAPY recompute without pull() over-states rewardBudget by un-pulled mintDebt
findings.note: NEW Low/QA at run phoenix-nft-staking-16. When mintDebt>0 is un-pulled and topUp/setTargetAPY recompute without a preceding pull(), _recomputeSchedule sizes rewardBudget on V=balance+mintDebt, so the 'Solvency holds at ALL times' Critical Invariant is transiently over-stated by exactly mintDebt; self-heals on the next _syncBudget (PoC: NFTStakerF02TransientSolvency). No extractable value (_safePay gates on real balanceOf and reverts on shortfall). Cross-referenced as spec-conformance F-02 (eventually-consistent invariant wording).
